name: IC — USB, 3V — QFN
description: Surface-mount 3V USB integrated circuit cluster in a QFN package, featuring a USB transceiver with a WQFN-28 footprint from the JLCPCB KiCad library.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a surface-mount 3V USB IC in a WQFN-28 footprint.
Verify footprint layout compatibility with WQFN-28_L5.0-W5.0-P0.50-BL-EP3.2.
Confirm that Tier B library quality from the JLCPCB KiCad library meets design standards.
avoid_when: Avoid when the application requires through-hole mounting.
Do not use if the layout requires a package family other than QFN.
Avoid if non-USB interface components or non-3V operating voltages are needed.
